package.description: Wireless Workbench 7 lets you remotely monitor and manage every piece of wireless audio gear connected to your system without interrupting the production.

en-US.description: Wireless Workbench 7 lets you remotely monitor and manage every piece of wireless audio gear connected to your system without interrupting the production.
en-US.longDescription:
Wireless Workbench is our free software for audio professionals that puts a full suite of RF spectrum management tools in one place to give you full command of your compatible wireless devices.
Guarantee that you are prepared to succeed in any RF environment – no matter the location.
